question_text: Describe the effect of INSERT INTO Guest(FirstName, Surname, Email) VALUES('Mina', 'Rao', 'mina@example.org'); on a suitable SQL table.
adaptation_rationale: Retains SQL insertion semantics; obsoletePHP/CGI execution mechanics excluded.
solution: It creates one new row in Guest, assigning the supplied values to the named columns. Existing rows remain unless a constraint error prevents the insertion.

marking_points.criterion: Explains successful insertion/constraint qualification without claiming an update to all rows.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.
